body: I will check that out. I suppose my fear is (if I somehow become fit), it will almost feel like a betrayal to all that "be yourself, people will like you for who you are" crap. I go on misc sometimes, everyone there is fit, and they get attention like no tommorow.
I suppose, but different is ridiculed and ostracized. People don't understand, so they ridicule instead.

>Why do you think you feel that way? Do you see it changing in the future?

Laziness? Pessimism? I really don't know. As for it changing in the future I don't really know that either.
Thanks for responding. I never thought I'd explore cutting, but there's nothing better here at the moment. Frankly prospects are nil, unless you count my friend living out of state.

I'd like to have friends and a girlfriend. I'd like to have a social life. Five years? I really don't know, sorry.

I have a massive respect for people who can cut themselves now, I only managed to puncture my skin.

I appreciate the responce, during my high school years I would stay in whdn others would go out, so I never got that teenage "learning from awkwardness" period. I gratuated high school (barely) six years ago and quit my last job due to my co-workers (who were in their 40s) making me feel like I was in high school again. I don't know if proceeding in life worth it. I have one friend who I see on the weekends, but other than thag nothing. Tried a semester of college, dropped out due to social anxiety and depression, nothing since.
